question: Which IAP packs drove the most revenue this month?
What was ARPDAU last week?
sql: SELECT activity_date, ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(dau), 0), 4) AS arpdau FROM main.monetization.gold_daily_revenue WHERE activity_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 7) GROUP BY activity_date ORDER BY activity_date

content: ARPDAU = total revenue_usd / DAU for the period. Use gold_daily_revenue.
'Revenue' means revenue_usd (already USD-normalized, net of store fees).
